title: Message composer allows sending concurrent messages during active turn
description: The message submit button only disables while sending is true, allowing additional messages to be posted while an active turn is still streaming on the same channel, conflicting with the single-stream reader.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): LIVE NOT REPRODUCED on AcceptLoopBot; CODE still risky.

Live: while `triage-concurrent-1` was active, Send stayed disabled; `triage-concurrent-2` only went after the first turn finished (fast AcceptLoopBot turn — may have overlapped with `sending===true`).

Code: composer `disabled={!draft.trim() || sending}` and `handleSend` only guards `sending`, not `turn` / `turnStatus === "active"`. After POST returns, a second send is allowed while the stream is still open.

Keep open as P2 latent: disable send while an active turn stream is open, or queue; re-test on a slow bot.
